blockingFindings.description: In the current arms-up and arm-cross previews, the sleeve tubes follow the observed arm silhouettes; the horizontal side projection is not visible in these regenerated poses.

Direct inspection of the neutral, back, side and prone previews shows the overskirt remains severely crumpled and asymmetric, with large rear-side fabric masses. The sit and crouch poses show large openings around the thighs and plate-like fabric sections hanging below the skirt. Narrow lavender trim sections read as detached straight bars across the side/back silhouette.

Across the regenerated front, side, neutral and seated previews, the bodice has visible irregular gray/pale patches and angular surface changes at the chest, side and waist. Images alone do not establish whether these are body penetration, missing faces, or overlapping geometry; the current appearance is not acceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
